lesson.basics.title: Start here: planning turns
lesson.first-shot.title: Your first shot
lesson.first-shot.instruction.0: Destroy the target with the highlighted laser.
lesson.energy.title: Energy and coordination
lesson.energy.instruction.0: Power the central laser for four shots.
lesson.energy.instruction.1: Android 1: weapons on turns 1–4. Android 3: lift, then energy to refill the reactor.
lesson.repairs.title: Repairing a malfunction
lesson.repairs.instruction.1: → on turn 1, then energy on turns 2–4.
lesson.battlebots.title: Battlebots and interceptors
lesson.battlebots.instruction.0: Collect the battlebots, then reach the interceptors.
lesson.battlebots.instruction.1: → · systems · ← · ← · systems. In flight, play battlebots to fire; leave a slot empty to return.
lesson.double-actions.title: Two actions, in order
lesson.double-actions.instruction.0: Move and fire with one card.
lesson.double-actions.instruction.1: Compare → + weapons with weapons + →: the order determines which laser fires.
lesson.phasing.title: Expansion threats
lesson.phasing.instruction.0: Hit the fighter while it is visible.
lesson.phasing.instruction.1: Weapons on turns 1–3. Watch the missed shot while it is phased out.
lesson.specializations.title: Specializations
lesson.specializations.instruction.0: Launch a rocket remotely with the Rocketeer.
lesson.specializations.instruction.1: Program the basic ability on turn 1. The rocket hits next turn.
app.name: Name
app.launch_cancelled_not_everyone_confir: Launch cancelled: not everyone confirmed within two minutes. Create a new session to try again.
app.everyone_confirms_their_presence_bef: Everyone confirms their presence before launch.
app.choose_a_turn_for_this_card: Choose a turn for this card.
app.click_a_card_to_fill_the_next_turn: Click a card to fill the next turn. Click a filled turn to clear it; Backspace undoes the last placement.
app.ready_lasts_two_minutes_we_wait_unti: Ready lasts two minutes. We wait until everyone is ready together.
app.programs_are_locked_advance_resoluti: Programs are locked. Advance resolution or review its steps.
app.move_tokens_during_data_transfer_the: Move tokens during data transfer. Their final positions are used during resolution.
app.left_center_and_right_correspond_to_: Left, center and right correspond to red, white and blue in the original announcements. Each threat’s miniature map shows its trajectory or affected rooms.
app.plan_choose_a_card_then_a_turn_click:
Plan. Choose a card then a turn; click a filled turn to retrieve its card. A operates a weapon, B transfers energy, C uses the station system. Arrows move your crew member. Planning does not move the real ship pieces; programs execute during resolution.

Coordinate. Each weapon fires once per turn. Heavy lasers and pulse draw from the zone reactor; light lasers have their own battery. A second crew member using the same lift is delayed.

Computer. Someone must perform C on the bridge within the first two turns of each phase (1–2, 4–5, 8–9), or the next actions are delayed.

Threats. Combine fire before subtracting enemy shields. Rockets hit on the following turn. Threats move after crew actions and execute X, Y and Z as they cross them.

Remote cooperation. Use external voice chat. Stay silent during communications blackouts; this page cannot mute your call.
app.forecast_without_crew_intervention_i: Forecast without crew intervention; includes the threat’s own speed changes.
app.continuing_requires_everyone_s_agree: Continuing requires everyone’s agreement. Returning ends the campaign before repairs.
app.next_mission_the_one_selected_in_set: Next mission: the one selected in setup.
app.requirements_checked_crew_agrees_whe: Requirements checked; crew agrees where required.
app.check_the_achievement_requirements_b: Check the achievement requirements before recording it.
app.this_permanently_locks_the_current_p: This permanently locks the current phase. Continue?
text.launch_a_rocket_from_any_station_a_: Launch a rocket from any station. A remote repair cannot finish a malfunction.
text.lower_right_launch_two_rockets_as_a: Lower right: launch two rockets as a strength-5 shot. Elsewhere: perform C.
text.maintain_the_computer_remotely_and_: Maintain the computer remotely and gain 1 point.
text.visual_confirmation_counts_as_three: Visual confirmation counts as three crew members. Elsewhere: perform C.
text.refuel_the_central_reactor_with_one: Refuel the central reactor with one capsule from any station.
text.upper_deck_temporary_shields_of_2_i: Upper deck: temporary shields of 2 in your zone and 1 elsewhere, for this turn.
text.fire_the_local_laser_and_pulse_cann: Fire the local laser and pulse cannon if both can operate. At the pulse station: normal fire.
text.pulse_strength_2_in_normal_range_st: Pulse: strength 2 in normal range, strength 1 one range farther. Elsewhere: perform A.
text.before_the_captain_enhance_the_firs: Before the captain: enhance the first A, B or battlebot action of crew in your station this turn. May accompany one movement.
text.before_the_captain_nobody_with_you_: Before the captain: nobody with you can be knocked out this turn; −1 point. Protection follows you. May accompany one movement.
text.teleport_the_departure_token_crew_m: Teleport the departure-token crew member to the arrival-token crew member. Assign tokens during data transfer.
text.from_a_side_zone_teleport_to_the_op: From a side zone: teleport to the opposite zone on the other deck.
text.lower_deck_all_threats_move_one_few: Lower deck: all threats move one fewer space this turn.
text.lower_center_on_turn_10_or_11_finis: Lower center on turn 10 or 11: finish this turn, then skip to the final turn without crew actions.
text.prepare_your_next_a_b_or_battlebot_: Prepare your next A, B or battlebot action: it becomes heroic.
text.combine_with_another_card_protect_i: Combine with another card: protect its execution from direct delays, obstacles and effects against you during the action.
text.active_battlebots_repair_one_damage: Active battlebots repair one damage in your zone, prioritizing weapons. Disabled battlebots are reactivated.
text.with_active_battlebots_except_in_lo: With active battlebots, except in lower right: reach the interceptors and launch. Already in space: heroic attack.
text.prepare_the_local_weapon_1_strength: Prepare the local weapon: +1 strength on its next laser shot, or +1 range for pulse.
text.repair_a_local_a_b_or_c_malfunction: Repair a local A, B or C malfunction by 2, prioritizing the lowest threat number.
text.untargetable_until_x_weapons_ignore: Untargetable until X: weapons ignore it.
text.cryoshield_absorbs_the_first_volley: Cryoshield absorbs the first volley regardless of strength.
text.ignore_its_shields_when_pulse_targe: Ignore its shields when pulse targets it this turn.
text.rockets_can_target_it_but_deal_no_d: Rockets can target it but deal no damage.
text.all_rockets_target_it_even_outside_: All rockets target it, even outside range; +1 shield after a rocket.
text.lone_interceptor_target_strength_9_: Lone interceptor target: strength 9, but the pilot is knocked out and battlebots disabled.
text.after_receiving_damage_attack_1_on_: After receiving damage, attack 1 on each zone at the end of damage calculation.
text.destroyed_deals_1_damage_to_every_o: Destroyed: deals 1 damage to every other external threat, ignoring shields.
text.returns_fire_disables_attacking_bat: Returns fire: disables attacking battlebots unless their attack is heroic.
text.after_x_disables_attacking_battlebo: After X, disables attacking battlebots unless their attack is heroic.
text.hit_points_equal_the_rockets_remain: Hit points equal the rockets remaining when it appears.
text.final_repair_knocks_out_crew_in_low: Final repair knocks out crew in lower left and lower right.
text.destroyed_knocks_out_its_attacker_a: Destroyed: knocks out its attacker and disables battlebots, even after a heroic attack.
text.each_battlebot_attack_clears_a_stat: Each battlebot attack clears a station. Clearing the third also clears the last.
text.entering_delays_the_next_action_ori: Entering delays the next action. Original: 2 hit points; each progeny: 1.
text.a_rocket_sends_it_off_course_it_wil: A rocket sends it off course: it will not perform its Z attack.
text.each_turn_it_is_targeted_loses_1_sh: Each turn it is targeted, loses 1 shield after damage.
text.alternates_visible_phased_out_while: Alternates visible / phased out. While phased out, cannot be hit and uses bracketed effects.
text.add_laser_strength_and_halve_it_rou: Add laser strength and halve it, rounding up; add other weapons before shields.
text.lasers_in_all_three_zones_can_targe: Lasers in all three zones can target it. Each weapon only hits it once per turn.
text.stops_at_z_if_still_present_at_the: Stops at Z. If still present at the jump, performs its Z attack.
text.gains_1_speed_after_each_threat_act: Gains 1 speed after each Threat Actions step.
text.speed_2_this_turn_if_weapon_fire_de: Speed 2 this turn if weapon fire deals damage; otherwise speed 4.
text.energy_absorbed_by_ship_shields_dur: Energy absorbed by ship shields during its attacks heals it by that amount.
text.the_final_repair_consumes_1_local_r: The final repair consumes 1 local reactor energy; it cannot finish with an empty reactor.
text.starts_in_upper_left_on_an_odd_thre: Starts in upper left on an odd threat number, upper right on an even number.
text.blocks_pulse_every_central_heavy_la: Blocks pulse. Every central heavy-laser shot triggers an attack 1 on every zone.
text.from_appearance_ninja_poisons_movem: From appearance, Ninja poisons movements starting or ending in upper right or lower center. After destruction, only already-poisoned crew remain threatened until Z.
text.existing_infections_persist_until_z: Existing infections persist until Z, even after its destruction.
text.whenever_damaged_all_crew_aboard_ch: Whenever damaged, all crew aboard change decks.
text.at_z_a_surprise_common_internal_thr: At Z, a surprise common internal threat resolves all its actions.
text.after_taking_damage_teleports_to_up: After taking damage, teleports to upper left.
text.if_not_destroyed_before_the_jump_kn: If not destroyed before the jump, knocks out all crew. Sabotaged systems are repaired separately.
text.attaches_to_the_first_crew_member_w: Attaches to the first crew member who moves, then follows them. Only another crew member can attack it. Destroying it knocks out its host; if the host is knocked out earlier, the threat survives.
text.targetable_only_at_range_or_less: Targetable only at range {maxTargetRange} or less.
text.at_most_weapon_damage_per_turn: At most {damageCap} weapon damage per turn.
text.destroyed_attack_strength_per_x_y_a: Destroyed: attack strength {asteroid} per X/Y already crossed.
text.requires_different_repairers_in_the: Requires {simultaneousRepairs} different repairers in the same turn.
text.repair_if_all_its_stations_are_repa: +{multiRepairBonus} repair if all its stations are repaired in the same turn.
text.interceptors_in_its_range_or_closer: Interceptors in its range or closer reduce its attacks by {carrier}.
text.absorbs_the_first_damage_each_turn: Absorbs the first {inaccessibility} damage each turn.
text.exactly_one_repairer_this_turn_repa: Exactly one repairer this turn: +{loneRepair} repair.
text.in_its_station_without_active_battl: in its station without active battlebots
text.plasma_knockout_if_no_damage_absorb: plasma: knockout if no damage absorbed
text.1_attack_to_other_external_threats_: +1 attack to other external threats until destroyed
text.1_shield_to_all_external_threats_un: +1 shield to all external threats until destroyed
text.entering_a_contaminated_station_cau: entering a contaminated station causes knockout
text.system_irreparable_or_remote_final_: system irreparable or remote final repair prohibited
text.no_rocket_available_or_already_laun: no rocket available or already launched this turn
text.sharing_their_station_with_another_: sharing their station with another crew member
text.subsequent_attacks_drain_shields_an: subsequent attacks drain shields and add that energy to damage
text.poisons_crew_starting_or_ending_a_m: poisons crew starting or ending a movement in upper right or lower center
text.cyber_gremlin_still_present_at_jump: Cyber Gremlin still present at jump
text.drain_1_reactor_energy_or_deal_1_da: Drain 1 reactor energy, or deal 1 damage if it is empty.
text.each_slime_spreads_one_station_towa: Each Slime spreads one station toward the opposite side.
text.disable_stored_battlebots_in_lower_: Disable stored battlebots in lower left.
text.move_to_the_adjacent_station_with_m: Move to the adjacent station with most crew; stay on a tie.
text.advance_other_internal_threats_one_: Advance other internal threats one space, executing crossed effects.
text.advance_other_external_threats_one_: Advance other external threats one space, executing crossed effects.
text.fill_its_shield_from_its_reactor: Fill its shield from its reactor.
text.empty_and_deal_that_much_damage: Empty {value1} and deal that much damage{value2}.
text.jump_to_the_trajectory_at_the_same_: Jump to the {value1} trajectory at the same distance, if space exists.
text.if_fewer_than_2_damage_reinforcemen: If fewer than 2 damage: reinforcement speed +1.
text.knock_out_crew_leading_active_battl: Knock out crew leading active battlebots; delay the rest.
text.advance_zone_threats_by_executing_c: Advance {value1} zone threats by {amount}, executing crossed effects.
text.deal_damage_to_the_opposite_side_zo: Deal {amount} damage to the opposite side zone.
text.consume_1_to_attack_each_zone_for_1: Consume 1 {value1} to attack each zone for 1.
text.move_one_station_toward_the_most_da: Move one station toward the most damaged zone; ties: toward the center.
text.crew_present_deal_2_zone_damage_oth: Crew present: deal 2 zone damage. Otherwise heal 1.
text.obscure_targeting_visual_confirmati: Obscure {value1} targeting. Visual confirmation or interceptors are required for laser fire there.
text.place_a_mine_in_its_station: Place a mine in its station.
text.each_mine_deals_2_damage_to_its_zon: Each mine deals 2 damage to its zone.
text.infect_all_crew_in_its_station: Infect all crew in its station.
text.each_conscious_infected_crew_member: Each conscious infected crew member aboard deals 2 damage to their zone.
text.knock_out_poisoned_crew_if_ninja_is: Knock out poisoned crew. If Ninja is still alive, each remaining rocket causes an attack 2 on the left, then is destroyed.
text.repeat_this_turn_s_actions_next_tur: Repeat this turn’s actions next turn, delaying the programs.
text.crew_in_side_zones_swap_left_right_: Crew in side zones swap left / right without changing deck.
text.reveal_the_surprise_threat_resolve_: Reveal the surprise threat; resolve its appearance, X, Y and Z.
text.empty_the_local_reactor_and_gain_th: Empty the local reactor and gain that much speed.
text.sabotage_a_b_and_c_in_its_station: Sabotage A, B and C in its station; each needs one repair.
text.drain_1_energy_from_the_host_statio: Drain 1 energy from the host station’s B system.
text.knock_out_other_crew_sharing_the_ho: Knock out other crew sharing the host’s station.
text.5_direct_damage_to_the_host_s_zone: 5 direct damage to the host’s zone; host in space: attack 5 in the center.
basics.arrows_move_change_deck_backspace: Arrows: move · ↑/↓: change deck · Backspace: undo · Enter: run
basics.shortcuts_arrow_keys_to_move_back: Shortcuts: arrow keys to move; Backspace to undo; Enter to run
basics.jump_to_5_seconds_before_the_dead: Jump to 5 seconds before the deadline
basics.in_space_alert_everyone_plans_the: In Space Alert, everyone plans their actions at the same time. Then the ship carries out those plans, turn by turn. Start here with one crew member and no threats.
basics.planning_is_finished_actions_now_: Planning is finished. Actions now play in order.
basics.the_first_card_has_played_look_at: The first card has played. Look at your position; the second card is still waiting.
basics.the_second_card_has_played_moving: The second card has played. Moving beyond the edge of the ship leaves you in place. Each slot is a turn, not a second.
basics.slot_3_is_empty_you_stay_put_in: Slot 3 is empty: you stay put. In a mission, every crew member carries out slot 1, then slot 2, and so on.
basics.the_clock_limits_how_long_you_hav: The clock limits how long you have to arrange cards. It does not move your crew member. Here you can start and pause it; in a mission it keeps running for everyone.
basics.choose_turn_1_or_2_you_can_also: Choose turn 1 or 2. You can also replace a card already there.
basics.choose_an_arrow_then_a_turn_you_c: Choose an arrow, then a turn. You can replace or remove your cards.
basics.planning_against_a_clock_and_carr: Planning against a clock and carrying out turns are two different parts of the game. Next, learn to use a weapon.
tactical.the_light_laser_has_its_own_bat: The light laser has its own battery: it spends no reactor energy.
tactical.firing_uses_1_energy_from_this_: Firing uses 1 energy from this zone’s reactor. With no energy when the shot resolves, the weapon does not fire.
tactical.one_fuel_capsule_fills_the_cent: One fuel capsule fills the central reactor to capacity.
tactical.b_transfers_energy_from_this_zo: B transfers energy from this zone’s reactor into its shield, up to capacity. That energy absorbs incoming attacks.
tactical.b_transfers_energy_from_the_cen: B transfers energy from the central reactor into this reactor, up to capacity.
tactical.perform_c_here_on_turns_1_2_4: Perform C here on turns 1–2, 4–5 and 8–9 to maintain the computer each phase and avoid delaying programs.
tactical.c_takes_this_room_s_battlebots_: C takes this room’s battlebots, or reactivates the team you already carry.
tactical.with_active_battlebots_c_launch: With active battlebots, C launches you in an interceptor. Only one crew member can be in space at a time.
tactical.c_performs_visual_confirmation_: C performs visual confirmation, which can earn points at the end of the mission.
tactical.c_launches_a_rocket_it_attacks_: C launches a rocket: it attacks on the following turn. Only one rocket can launch each turn.
tactical.program_on_a_turn_when_your_cre: Program {value1} on a turn when your crew member will be in this room. A malfunction of this system makes the action repair it instead.
tactical.program_an_card_to_change_deck_: Program an ↑↓ card to change deck in this zone.
tactical.program_a_left_or_right_arrow_t: Program a left or right arrow to enter the next room on the same deck.
tutorial.destination_missed_go_back_and_: Destination missed. Go back and plan another route.
tutorial_controller.the_clock_limits_pla: One slot = one turn. This first exercise plays just three turns, after planning.
tutorial_controller.place_a_shot_in_each: Place a shot in each highlighted slot, then ↵.
tutorial_controller.reach_the_marked_roo: Reach the marked room in two actions. Leave the third slot empty: wait.
tutorial_controller.program_locked_crew_: Program locked. Crew act together, then threats.
tutorial_controller.destination_reached_: Destination reached! Your program took you there.
tutorial_controller.replay_to_compare_an: Replay to compare another program, or move on.
timing.start_clock: Start the clock, then plan a route to the marked room.
timing.plan_early: Reach the room in two actions. Press ↵ when your program is ready.
timing.executing: The clock has stopped. All three turns execute in order.
timing.early_done: Your route worked. Next: try an unfinished program when time runs out.
timing.deadline_plan: Place one arrow. Leave the other two slots empty.
timing.empty_waits: Time is up: the arrow executes, then the two empty slots wait.
timing.complete: Finish early or run out of time: the whole program executes. Empty slots wait.
timing.phase_one: Plan the first three shots, then advance the clock to phase 2. The ship waits.
timing.phase_two: Turns 1–3 are locked. Add the fourth shot, then run the whole mission.
lesson.planning-phases.title: The clock and planning phases
lesson.planning-phases.instruction.0: This training mission has 7 turns: plan 1–3, then 4–7. They all execute at the end.
phases.start: Start the clock and place → in turn 1. Listen for the next announcement.
phases.listen: The clock advances; the ship waits. Threats are announced during planning.
phases.revealed: Threat revealed: it will arrive on execution turn 6. Place → in turn 1, then jump to the last 5 seconds of this phase.
phases.locked: Turns 1–3 are locked; the ship still waits. Place a deck change in turn 4, then ↵.
phases.all_turns: All 7 turns now execute. The threat enters on turn 6.
phases.skip: Jump to the last 5 seconds of phase 1
overview.plan_detail: ≈ 10 min · Plan together as threats are announced.
overview.lock_detail: Each phase locks a group of turns.
overview.play_detail: Every turn, in order. No more planning.
route.assumption: Intended route without disruptions: delays, threats or a busy lift may change it.
timing.deadline_ready: Start the last 5 seconds. Let the clock run out.
timing.deadline_running: Wait for zero: your unfinished program will execute automatically.
